title: Provenance Record
description: Binds a frozen artifact to its hash, source references, freeze event, exposure-state history, and an honest statement of which storage controls actually apply. Provenance records are append-only in practice; a correction is a new record referencing the prior one.

record_id.description: Unique identifier for this provenance record.

artifact_id.description: The artifact_id (from the manifest) this record describes.

hash_algorithm.description: Only SHA-256 is used in this repository.

sha256.description: Lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the frozen bytes, or null if the artifact is NOT_PRESENT. Never fabricated.

source_artifact_refs.description: artifact_ids this artifact was derived from or references.

artifact_file_ref.description: Repo-relative path of the file whose exact bytes sha256 covers. Binds the hash to specific content (non-substitution). Null when the artifact is NOT_PRESENT or a bundle-of-hashes method is described below.

freeze_event.description: The freeze act, or null if the artifact is not (yet) frozen.

method.description: How the bytes were canonicalized/hashed (e.g. binary-safe, normalization applied). Supports reproducible hashing across platforms.

exposure_state_history.description: Ordered history of exposure-state recordings. Preserved, never rewritten favorably.

controls.description: Honest statement of which of the three independent controls actually apply. These are separate and must not be collapsed.

storage_immutability.description: Control A. Git presence is provenance-contributing but is NOT WORM storage.

worm_storage.description: True only if genuine WORM/object-lock storage is in force. Currently false.

git_history_present.description: Whether the artifact is committed to Git. Provenance-contributing; not equivalent to WORM.

storage_type.description: e.g. 'git-only', or a future immutable-store identifier. Null if unspecified.

manifest_ref.description: Path or id of the manifest, or null.

workflow_eligibility.description: Control C. Eligibility is an explicit determination, never automatic.

eligible.description: True/false only if an explicit eligibility determination exists; null if undetermined (default).

determination_ref.description: Reference to the governance record making the eligibility determination, or null if none.

supersedes_record.description: record_id of a prior provenance record this one corrects/replaces, or null.

notes.description: Free-text notes. Must not contain protected information.

allOf.comment: Control C cannot self-assert: eligible:true requires a reference to the governance eligibility determination.
A freeze event and a real hash are inseparable (PROVENANCE_RULES.md §3): a recorded freeze_event requires a non-null sha256.
Absent bytes (sha256 null) cannot have a freeze event: no freeze may be fabricated for content that does not exist.
